name: Skyeye Laser Technology Limited
supervisors: China Academy of Engineering Physics (per the Canadian and US lists)

evidence.summary: Canada’s Named Research Organizations list names Skyeye Laser Technology among the known aliases of the China Academy of Engineering Physics (CAEP). The US Commerce Department added it to the Entity List in 2020, citing its procurement of US-origin items, as one of ten entities owned by, operated by or directly affiliated with CAEP, the complex responsible for researching, developing and testing China’s nuclear weapons; the listing gives Mianyang Tianyan Laser Technology as its alias and places it in Mianyang.
